newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-SPURS' AVERY JOHNSON OUT AFTER MINOR THROAT SURGERY.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-SPURS' AVERY JOHNSON OUT AFTER MINOR THROAT SURGERY.

text.p: The injury-ravaged San Antonio Spurs lost Avery Johnson for at least the next four games after the point guard underwent minor throat surgery on Monday.
Johnson had an abscess in his throat drained and was expected to remain hospitalized for two to three days while receiving intravenous fluids and antibiotics.

Johnson, who is averaging 10.7 points and 7.3 assists per game, had missed the last two games due to strep throat, snapping a consecutive games played streak at 378, including a Spurs-record 296 in a row.

He joins the long list of Spurs who have been sidelined this season by injury, including star centre David Robinson and forward Charles Smith, who have missed virtually the entire season, forwards Chuck Person, Dominique Wilkins and Sean Elliott and guards Vernon Maxwell and Vinny Del Negro.
